measure_performance_with_context_manager: use PerformanceReport as a context manager to measure wall, CPU, and CUDA time for a named block of code
compare_two_performance_reports: run the compare CLI command to diff a target performance report JSON against a baseline report JSON
get_environment_snapshot: create an Environment dataclass to capture PyTorch version, GPU/CPU info, and installed library versions
calculate_measurement_statistics: use MeasurementStats to collect samples and compute min, max, mean, median, and standard deviation
compare_environment_changes: call Environment.compare to find added, removed, changed, and unchanged attributes between two environment snapshots
